## Details

<a id="title_colour_ram"></a>
### [`title_colour_ram`](../../../../src/data/title_picture.asm#L6) `$5800-$5BE7`

*data*

Title picture: the 1000 colour RAM bytes (low nybbles; all high nybbles are 6). The Mayday! code at $0810 shows the title picture before the program starts. At run time $5800-$59ff holds the sprite data.
